PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, AUGUST 15, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

Richard Lewis, Chair  Susana Gonzalez Edmond, Commissioner
Jane Templin, Vice Chair  Josh LaFarga, Commissioner
Alvaro Castillo, Commissioner  Michele Ware, Commissioner
Michael Clemson, Commissioner

  PLANNING COMMISSION IN-PERSON MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT EMAIL COMMENTS TO
  PLANNINGCOMMISSIONERS@LONGBEACH.GOV

  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION OR BY PRESSING *9 ON YOUR PHONE

  TO JOIN VIA ZOOM, PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 927 4212 9521
  https://www.longbeach.gov/lbcd/planning/commission/

 PLEASE NOTE THE ZOOM MEETING MAY ENCOUNTER TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS, BUT IN-
  PERSON ACCESS AND PUBLIC COMMENT WILL CONTINUE TO BE AVAILABLE IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH THE BROWN ACT

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-54546  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-54547  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Planning Commission meeting
  of Thursday, August 1, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-54548  Recommendation to accept Categorical Exemption CE-24-101 and approve a Site
  Plan Review (SPR24-052) and Conditional Use Permit (CUP24-007) and adopt the
  proposed findings and conditions of approval thereto, to permit the conversion of
  approximately 2,854 square feet of office space into self-storage and the

  Page 1 of 3
   PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, AUGUST 15, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  construction of a new (unattached) approximately 112,978 square feet self-storage
  building, on a 1.03 acre lot located at 1700 Santa Fe Avenue, in the Industrial
  General (IG) Zoning District. (District 7)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-54549  Recommendation to find the projects listed in the proposed Fiscal Year 2025
  Capital Improvement Program (FY 2025 CIP) in conformity with the General Plan.
  (Citywide)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-54550  Recommendation to receive and file a study session on the implementation of and
  potential updates to the Inclusionary Housing Ordinance (Chapter 21.67) that
  currently require market rate housing developments to include a proportion of
  affordable units in the development project. Potential changes include expanding
  the requirement citywide and changing the affordability level requirements, amongst
  other changes. (Citywide)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Planning Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
